features.title: One inbox for every channel
features.text: Web chat, email and WhatsApp arrive in the same place. Everyone can see who is replying, so nothing gets lost.

features.title: The right person answers
features.text: Professionals and peers work in groups. Rules based on channel, language or entry questions route each request to the right group.

features.title: As much AI as needed
features.text: The assistant answers routine questions from your own knowledge base. For sensitive topics, signs of crisis or on request, it hands over to a human.

features.title: Data protection, guaranteed at all times
features.text: Hosted in Switzerland or on your own server. AI requests only go to providers that neither store data nor use it for training.

features.title: In the language of the person asking
features.text: Automatic translation and suggested replies in plain language.

features.title: Reporting
features.text: Response times and feedback at a glance, exports without message content.

einsatz.title: Counselling services and parent advice
einsatz.text: Answer frequent questions quickly and connect worried people with a professional fast.

einsatz.title: Patient organisations and peer programmes
einsatz.text: Experienced peers and professionals answer side by side, with clear routing for medical questions.

einsatz.title: Hospitals and medical practices
einsatz.text: Bring questions that come up between appointments together in one place. Medical concerns go straight to your team.

einsatz.title: Disability insurance (IV) offices and social services
einsatz.text: Explain procedures clearly, in plain language or translated, and hand over as soon as it concerns someone’s own case.
